 UCLA Football Ranked No. 8 in First College Football Playoff Rankings 
 Football November 03, 2026 The Bruins' (8-0, 5-0 Big Ten) No. 8 ranking matches their highest in CFP history.
 Tickets Schedule UCLA Football was ranked No. 8 in the first College Football Playoff (CFP) rankings of the 2026 season. The CFP selection committee unveiled its initial top 25 rankings on ESPN Tuesday afternoon.
 The Bruins’ (8-0, 5-0 Big Ten) No. 8 ranking matches their highest in CFP history, previously achieved on Nov. 25, 2014. The ranking marks UCLA’s first appearance in the CFP top 25 since Oct. 31, 2023, when the Bruins were ranked No. 19.
 Bob Chesney , the Angelo M. Mazzone III UCLA Head Football Coach, has directed the Bruins to one of the greatest single-season turnarounds in program history in his first year in Westwood. UCLA, one of three remaining unbeaten FBS teams, sits atop the Big Ten Conference standings with four games remaining in the regular season.
 UCLA boasts one of the top defenses in the country, ranking in the top 10 nationally in scoring defense (13.4 points per game), total defense (260.8 yards allowed per game), rushing defense (87.3 yards allowed per game), takeaways (26), turnover margin (+15), interceptions (16) and fumble recoveries (10). Offensively, the Bruins lead the Big Ten in rushing yards per game (219.5), rushing touchdowns (25) and yards per carry (5.44).
 The CFP selection committee will announce five more sets of rankings, including four weekly announcements on Tuesdays and the final unveiling of the 12-team playoff bracket on Sunday, Dec. 6. Below is the complete schedule of remaining rankings announcements.
 2026 College Football Playoff Rankings Schedule

Tuesday, Nov. 10 – 6-6:30 p.m. PT
Tuesday, Nov. 17 – 6-6:30 p.m. PT
Tuesday, Nov. 24 – 4:30-5 p.m. PT
Tuesday, Dec. 1 – 4-4:30 p.m. PT
